name: password-field
title: Password field
description: A password input with a Show / Hide button: named with the visible word first, change announced, paste never blocked, autocomplete set, hidden again on submit.
docs: Akso UI Password field. Put it inside a Field with a FieldLabel; use autoComplete="new-password" for sign-up. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md
